0.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_000_000
0.description: My <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what an honor! Have you business with Lord Aurvael?
0.translation_description: <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, che onore! Hai affari con Lord Aurvael?

1.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_000
1.description: My <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what an honor! How may I serve you this day?
1.translation_description: <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, che onore! Come posso servirti oggi?

2.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_010
2.description: You have a mind to employ your gathering skills for the benefit of the restoration effort, you say? Marvelous, marvelous! It shall be my pleasure to provide you with an explanation of our work!
2.translation_description: Vuoi mettere le tue abilità di raccolta al servizio della ricostruzione? Magnifico, magnifico! Sarà un piacere spiegarti il nostro lavoro!

3.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_020
3.description: As you're doubtless already aware, the Firmament's reconstruction demands a veritable mountain of materials. In order to meet this need, it was decided that we would harness the Diadem's abundance of resources.
3.translation_description: Come probabilmente già sai, la ricostruzione del Firmamento richiede una quantità enorme di materiali. Per soddisfare questa necessità, abbiamo deciso di sfruttare le abbondanti risorse del Diadema.

4.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_030
4.description: Able gatherers such as your good self may venture forth to the isles and bring back materials to be used in the Firmament's reconstruction.
4.translation_description: Raccoglitori esperti come te possono recarsi sulle isole e riportare materiali da usare per la ricostruzione del Firmamento.

5.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_040
5.description: Given the nature of the isles, however, we must make certain that materials found there are not...shall we say, <hex:021A020203>tainted<hex:021A020103>, before we put them to use.
5.translation_description: Vista la natura di quelle isole, però, dobbiamo assicurarci che i materiali raccolti non siano... come dire, <hex:021A020203>contaminati<hex:021A020103>, prima di usarli.

6.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_050
6.description: To that end, we ask that you bring all the items you have gathered to myself for inspection.
6.translation_description: Per questo ti chiediamo di portarmi tutti i materiali che hai raccolto, così che io possa ispezionarli.

7.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_060
7.description: Those items that are deemed safe will be returned to you with a seal of approval.
7.translation_description: Quelli che saranno ritenuti sicuri ti verranno restituiti con il nostro sigillo di approvazione.

8.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_070
8.description: And lest you wonder─yes, fish are also subject to inspection.<hex:02100103>...By your puzzled expression, I see you struggle to fathom what use the restoration effort has for fish.
8.translation_description: E, se te lo stai chiedendo: sì, anche i pesci devono essere sottoposti a ispezione.<hex:02100103>... Dal tuo sguardo perplesso, capisco che fai fatica a immaginare a cosa possano servire i pesci per la ricostruzione.

9.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_073
9.description: You see, the fish that inhabit the Diadem are known to consume unusual things, and through inspection, we determine whether a creature holds resources in its belly. Once this is confirmed, you may help yourself to the bounty with a quick spot of desynthesis.
9.translation_description: I pesci che popolano il Diadema sono noti per inghiottire cose insolite. Con l'ispezione verifichiamo se hanno inghiottito risorse che puoi recuperare con una rapida desintesi.

10.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_077
10.description: Now then, you are surely curious as to what you stand to gain for your troubles. In recognition of the dangers of the Diadem, we offer skybuilders' scrips by way of recompense.
10.translation_description: Ora ti starai chiedendo quale ricompensa spetti a chi affronta i rischi del Diadema. Per questo ti daremo Gettoni dei Costruttori Celesti.

11.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_080
11.description: Furthermore, all materials you find are yours to do with as you please. For whether you choose to sell them to crafters or craft with them yourself, they will ultimately benefit the reconstruction!
11.translation_description: Inoltre, tutti i materiali che troverai resteranno tuoi. Che tu decida di venderli agli artigiani o di usarli per creare oggetti, contribuirai comunque alla ricostruzione!

12.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_010_090
12.description: And that concludes my explanation. If you've a mind to travel to the Diadem for this endeavor, pray present yourself to Lord Aurvael beside me for further information.
12.translation_description: Ecco, ho finito di spiegarti tutto. Se vuoi andare al Diadema per dare una mano, chiedi a Lord Aurvael, qui accanto a me, altre informazioni.

13.name: TEXT_CTSHWDINSPECTION_00660_FLOTPASSANT_020_000
13.description: If you have materials from the Diadem requiring inspection, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>, I should be pleased to assist you!
13.translation_description: Se hai materiali del Diadema da far controllare, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>, sarà un piacere aiutarti!
